literal: Tip of branch they who climbed, that having exceeded if they strive, to life end having become it will leave.
translation: If those who have climbed to the very tip of a branch try to push beyond it, it will result in the end of their life.
modern: ஒரு மரக்கிளையின் நுனிவரை ஏறியவர்கள், அந்த எல்லையைத் தாண்டி மேலே செல்ல முயன்றால், அது அவர்களின் உயிருக்கே முடிவாகிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet uses the vivid image of climbing a tree to illustrate the danger of overstepping one's limits. The words 'நுனி' (tip) and 'கொம்பர்' (branch) set the scene of someone who has already reached the highest possible point. If they strive ('ஊக்கின்') to go beyond ('இறந்து') that limit ('அஃது'), they will inevitably fall. It serves as a powerful metaphor for knowing the boundaries of one's power and position, warning that excessive ambition beyond one's capacity leads to ruin.
